rules: Every blocking failure must have exactly one primary owner class and evidence.
Canonical-language-invalid defects are repaired in generated source/Vibe generation.
Fixture incompleteness is repaired in fixtures, not business state.
Runtime-adapter conformance defects are handed to the adapter owner and must not produce playbook workarounds.
Compiler/verifier parity gaps add a trusted Vibe regression without redefining Ordo.
